title: Umien™ Granite Mortar and Pestle Set - 100% Granite - 3.5-Cups - 8-Inch – Avocado Tool Included – Natural Stone Molcajete for Spices, Pestos, & Guacamole (Grey) - Stone Grinder - Guacamole
description:
About this item
LARGE CAPACITY: Featuring an 8-inch diameter and 3.5-cup capacity, this granite mortar and pestle set is perfect for grinding, crushing, and mixing spices, herbs, grains, and more. Create delicious guacamole, salsas, and sauces effortlessly!
AUTHENTIC MOLCAJETE DESIGN: Handcrafted with natural granite, this mortar and pestle boasts a stunning color pattern that complements your kitchen décor while doubling as a stylish serving bowl for your favorite recipes
EASY TO USE & CLEAN: Designed for convenience, this mortar and pestle set is simple to use and easy to hand wash, making it a durable kitchen essential you’ll reach for time and time again
BLACK & GREY: Two colors with the perfect size to meet your culinary needs, whether you’re preparing small batches of spices or larger portions of guacamole BONUS AVOCADO TOOL
MAKE DELICIOUS SALSA, GUACAMOLE & MORE: Perfect for grinding and mixing fresh ingredients to create mouthwatering recipes like guacamole, salsa, pesto, and more. Elevate your cooking experience with authentic flavors crafted right in your kitchen
reviews_5s:
I needed a larger mortar and pestle to make guacamole, as well as grinding dried herbs. This 3.5 cup size is perfect. It comes with an anti-scratch pad that prevents the granite from scratching the counter surface, affixed with self adhesive. While it does not say it is dishwasher safe, I have put it in my dishwasher with no issues. I chose not use the anti-scratch pad for that reason and place it on a silicone matt instead. The rounded end of the pestle club is comfortable to hold in your hand and has a good-sized grinding surface. I like how this sits firmly on the countertop.
Mortars that sit on legs can tip when you are pressing down on firmer food. No way this mortar bowl will ever tip over! It is made of very sturdy, thick granite. The bonus avocado "knife" is a nice addition, too.Excellent product, I use it everyday to make guacamole. Luv It!Got this as a Mother’s Day gift for mi suegra, excellent quality and heavyyy!I have been looking for a while for a larger size, mortar and pedestal. This one is perfect. Highly recommend this one if you’re doing larger quantities of stuff.exactly what i was looking for, priced right and great quailtyMuy bonito no pesa mucho y si está bonitoExactly what my chef wife needed the piece is perfectPerfect size and materialGreat purchaseVery nice!
reviews_1s:
Received product I was pleased with the quick delivery, but it has a couple of deep holes in the inside surface. It makes it difficult to get it cleaned properly. Not happy at all about that.I ordered this for the holiday. It arrived at my daughters location without a pestle. I have reached out to UMIEN THREE TIMES to correct the order and they have NEVER REPLIED. Avoid this product and anything from this company. I wish I could rate this ZERO stars.Looks good but the pestle came split in 2 so it unusable. The person who received the gift waited a couple months to open it so I don't have an option to return. Hopefully the manufacturer will do the right thing and replace the pestle.There are instructions given before using the mortar. What if someone does not read carefully and starts using the product. Their food might get contaminated by granite residue. Plus who has time for following all the steps till we don't see any gray residue.
Why did they even sell an unfinished product?
Everytime we make something we have to wash only with water. Like seriously. If I wash it everytime with water after few months it will get rusted or will have mold on it growing. How is it supposed to be maintained?This bowl is very stylish and looks great, but the functionality is not great.

It is potentially dangerous to eat from this bowl. After using it a few times, I noticed the granite was chipping away regularly. The stone is deposited into the guacamole gradually. You can easily test this out by wiping the bowl with a warm damp paper towel and seeing the black and grey deposits that will show on the paper towel.

Generally speaking, I think granite is the wrong material to make guacamole bowls out of. I think it is time to reconsider the potential for mass-manufactured stone bowls. I would recommend a wood or ceramic bowl that is smooth. The pestle here works well, but the bowl and pestle are not a good combination. I use the pestle when I make guacamole but this bowl is in the back of my cabinet. I would use it for wrapped candies or something of that nature, but not going to eat out of the bowl again.This appears to be made of some kind of crushed rock and concrete or other binding material. When I first picked it up, particles were all over my hands. I tried to wash it, I filled it up with water and the water was dark grey and filthy. Who knows what it's made of, but I would never serve food in this as the materials would come off into the food. It's made in China so who knows what is in it. I shipped it back the day I got it. Going to find something solid, made in America out of materials I can be sure of. I was hoping for an authentic Molcajete, well made of granite or bassalt. Williams-Sonoma has some nice ones.I did not receive the grey grinder only the cheap green plastic one. Highly disappointed.it was broken before arrivalProduct is heavy and appears to be well made. Item did not come with the advertised bonus avocado slicer. Inquired but have received no response from the company to date.I have had this for a few months and it’s definitely not pure granite. You can tell it was put in a mould, so a mix of different materials. Also, my mortar is rusting.
